Finlux: Very (403 Access Denied) and EE (Incapsula block) could not be read, and Laptops Direct's page for the Finlux MU24F 50in Fire TV (50MU24F, JSON-LD price GBP 329) says 'This product is no longer available', so no current Finlux price is recorded.
Blaupunkt: Currys returned a Cloudflare 403 and no reachable retailer page for a current Blaupunkt TV was found, so none is recorded.

Techwood: AO's own brand and ao.com returned a Cloudflare 403; the only page reached, Laptops Direct's Techwood 65AO5USB, says 'This product is no longer available' (and shows an old A+ energy class), so none is recorded.

Linsar: no Linsar TV appears in any listing read (Richer Sounds' first 300 'All TVs' entries, Atlantic Electrics' television collection, the DID and Euronics TV collections, Expert's 56 TVs, Power City's 22-43in page), so none is recorded.
Manhattan: only Freeview Play set-top boxes and streamers (T3, T4, Aero) surfaced in search and on one Richer Sounds record, and no Manhattan television model was found on any page read.
Ferguson: no Ferguson TV appears in any listing read, and search only surfaced trade news about Cello relaunching the brand, which is not a priced product page, so none is recorded.

Sharp UK range: Currys, AO and Argos are blocked, so only five Sharp sets are priced (Atlantic Electrics 1TC32DI2KL2AB, 1TC32HE2245KB and 1TC32HE2245KW, Richer Sounds 32HE3245K and 40HE3245K), not Sharp's larger 4K sets.
Toshiba current UK range: Currys, AO and Argos are blocked, so the UK shows only Richer Sounds 32WF2653DB, and Ireland shows only Power City 24WV3553 and 32WV3553, not Toshiba's larger sets.

Euronics Ireland: its Toshiba 43UA2063DB (published 2021) and 55QA4C63DB (published 2022) and its Walker WPT2421SAT, WPT3220LED, 39WPS21, WP4K55221BRD and WPT2421DVD (published 2021-2024) are all shown sold out and are older lines, so they were left out as not current, while the two 2026 Walker listings that were kept (WPS2K40241 and WPS2KQLED40251) are also shown sold out online but carry a price.

Panasonic, Philips, Sharp, Hitachi and Grundig in Ireland: Harvey Norman IE returned a Cloudflare 403 to both tools, and the DID smart-TV collection, Euronics, Expert (56 TVs: Samsung, LG, Hisense, Sony, Walker, NordMende) and Power City's 22-43in page list none of them, so no Irish offer exists in this file for those makers.

On-mode watts: only the seven Panasonic products have a watt figure (UK fiches on Hughes); Richer Sounds, DID, Power City and Euronics print the label energy only as kWh/1000h (for example Power City Toshiba 32WV3553 'energy consumption 26', Richer Sounds Philips 55PUS8001 '77 kwh'), which is not watts and was not converted, and DID's Telefunken fields are mislabelled or swapped on several items.
Philips watts and EPREL numbers: philips.co.uk/c-p/55PUS8001_12/ returned an error page and the Richer Sounds product page prints no fiche or EPREL number, so Philips has no onModeWatts or eprel.
Power City fiche: the product page links /groups/product/energyfiche?id=32WV3553 to a PDF at powercity.cdn.webangel.ie/energyfiche/32WV3553.pdf, which answered 404, so Toshiba 32WV3553 has no watts.

Panasonic fiches: ten of the 17 Hughes Panasonic models have no onModeWatts, because eight have a fiche link on the Hughes listing that was not fetched within the budget (TV-48Z90BEB, TV-43W85BEY, TB-65W61AEY, TV-65W85BEY, TV-42Z90BEB, TV-65Z90BEB, TV-50W85BEY, TV-77Z90BEB) and TB-50W61AEY and TV-40S55AEYC show no fiche link.

Panasonic native refresh rate and model year are not printed on the Hughes listing or the fiches (the fiche 'default' 50/100/120 Hz is not the native rate), so refreshHz and year are null for Panasonic; the W61 series' smart OS is also not stated in its Hughes title.

Power City: product codes 241SA, 31411, 31145, 332993 and the QLED32 and QLED40 shorthand are retailer codes without a model-style number, so those Walker and Toshiba lines were left out; the kept Walker codes (for example 2K40241) may be the same sets as Euronics' WPS-prefixed codes but are not merged.

Richer Sounds' 'All TVs' list was read for its first 300 entries only (newest first), so older Panasonic, Sharp, Toshiba and other-maker lines beyond them are not covered, and only Hughes' Panasonic brand page was fetched from Hughes.

John Lewis and Sonic Direct: John Lewis was not reached (no listing URL known), and Sonic Direct's TV page was read only for its brand navigation (Haier, Hisense, LG, Panasonic, Samsung, Sony, TCL, all already covered or excluded), so neither adds an offer.
Currys, AO, Argos, Very and Harvey Norman IE all refused automated access (403) from this network, so none of their listings, prices or EPREL numbers are in this file.
